description: Standalone CT OEC source-candidate acquisition and offline normalization with durable app receipts and retained-input reuse.

acquiredManifestPath.description: Explicit verified retained acquisition; omission selects fixed native collection.

output_schema_contract.zip: ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate; missing ZIP preserved as gap
output_schema_contract.geocode: Null latitude/longitude; no selected coordinates or business polygons
output_schema_contract.entity: Source candidates, not verified physical sites or unique businesses

redirect_policy: Fixed native CT endpoints, redirects rejected and credentials omitted; retained mode performs no network requests.
publisher_exclusion: Native app acquisition owns data/business-sources/ct-childcare/runtime/publisher.lock across output roots until child writers drain and terminal persistence completes. Unknown ownership is never stolen. Injected tests and retained offline runs do not take the native publisher lock.
retry: No automatic source retries or job restart; preserve completed acquisitions for explicit downstream reprocessing without repulling.
checkpoint: Persist start before acquisition, then verified acquired and normalized references after each child publication, including child commit-boundary cancellation. Publish terminal receipt last without overwrite.
idempotency: Immutable UUID app and child outputs; native/injected modes cannot borrow another job's children. Retained mode pins an explicitly selected acquisition. No source-current or national pointer updates.
cancellation: Cooperative 30-minute deadline and drained writers before terminal persistence and ownership release. Preserve published evidence on failure/cancellation; forced termination or OS stalls require inspection.
retention_profile: Internal selected source, candidate/quarantine output and immutable linked app receipts, with unverified premises/identity and nullable geographic gaps preserved.
